claims.claim: Public Product Intelligence exports add exactly GroundedAnswerError, GroundedAnswerStatus, GroundedAnswer, and create_grounded_answer, with no prompt, provider, parser, service, storage, ranking, truth-resolution, or orchestration API.

GroundedAnswerStatus contains exactly ANSWERED, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, and CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE, and docs state these are application states rather than canonical product truth or M2 recommendation/approval states.

GroundedAnswer is frozen/immutable, contains exactly the five required fields, and retains the exact supplied CanonicalRagContext object without copying, rebuilding, or rerunning retrieval/context construction.
create_grounded_answer strictly validates exact context/status/value types, nonblank answer_text, the 32768-byte UTF-8 answer bound, and preserves accepted answer text exactly.

Citation validation accepts only unique context-local hit, witness, and retained supplemental-evidence addresses from the exact supplied context; fabricated, duplicate, cross-context, omitted-evidence, malformed, or otherwise non-resolving references fail closed while accepted citation order is preserved.

ANSWERED requires at least one valid witness/evidence leaf citation; CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE requires at least two distinct valid leaf citations; hit headers alone cannot satisfy those rules; INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE permits zero valid citations.
limitations are bounded immutable ordered strings; non-answer statuses require at least one limitation, invalid/blank/oversized/excess items fail closed, and ANSWERED may have no limitations.

Tests prove citation addresses remain scoped to the supplied context, supplemental evidence omitted by M3 byte budgeting cannot be cited, equal-looking/conflicting source values are not deduplicated or interpreted, and answer construction does not mutate the canonical context or any source evidence.

Successful construction performs zero provider/model/AgentLoop/tool/browser/network/filesystem/SQLite/Drive/environment/clock/random/UUID/subprocess/queue/background work and leaves M2 scoring/ranking/approval plus M3 knowledge/retrieval/context authorities unchanged.

Focused regressions cover all three statuses, exact context identity retention, exact answer preservation, UTF-8 bounds, hit/witness/evidence citation resolution, duplicate and fabricated citations, leaf minimums, no-hit abstention, limitation bounds, immutability, repeated determinism, no-I/O/no-model behavior, and documentation records TASK-129 as structural grounding only with no semantic-entailment guarantee.
